Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Junior Research Fellow position at IISER Bhopal?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Junior Research Fellow position at IISER Bhopal is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Chemistry with a specialization in Organic Chemistry, along with a valid NET (CSIR/UGC JRF/LS) or GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Project Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Online Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit specified for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for this position. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any specific details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs are required.

faq.question: Q9. Is research experience mandatory for this role?
faq.answer: While not mandatory, candidates with some form of research experience would be preferred for this position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Project Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The position is on a contractual basis.
